name: io.github.tydung26/websupport-mcp
title: Websupport
description: Manage a Websupport account: DNS, FTP, hosting, databases, mailboxes, VPS and invoices.

environmentVariables.name: WEBSUPPORT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key identifier from WebAdmin (Security -> API keys). Generate a Standard pair; a DynDNS pair authenticates against one endpoint only.

environmentVariables.name: WEBSUPPORT_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API secret paired with the key. Used only to sign requests; it is never transmitted.

environmentVariables.name: WEBSUPPORT_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Market selection. Defaults to https://rest.websupport.sk. Also live: rest.websupport.cz, rest.websupport.hu, rest.websupport.se.

environmentVariables.name: WEBSUPPORT_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the 13 write tools. Omit for a read-only deployment, where they never appear in tools/list at all.

environmentVariables.name: WEBSUPPORT_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the 7 destructive tools, each of which also requires confirm: true on every call. Independent of WEBSUPPORT_ALLOW_WRITE.
